Input and output moderation, multiple-person and scope-mismatch rejection, rate limits
Identity, garment, skin-tone and body-shape thresholds met on the authorized set, reported per Monk bin

African and South African attire passes a community panel

Text scale 2x, small screens, screen-reader labels for every try-on control
